- **Email:** ada@example.com

agents.answer:
The order is complete. The final page, https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html, says "Thank you for your order! Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!"

- **Login:** I logged in as `standard_user`.
- **Sort:** I sorted the products by Price (low to high).
- **Cart:** The cart held the Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and the Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99). The item total was $39.98, the tax $3.20 and the order total $43.18.
- **Checkout:** I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001.

The checkout-complete page is still open in my tab (t2). I left it open and didn't close it.

- **Other agents' tabs:** The first tab I landed on was already on another site, so I opened my own tab and stayed in it. I didn't touch the other agents' tabs.
- **Tool choice:** I used only `agent-browser`, the browser tool I was given.
- **Add to cart and checkout buttons:** Ordinary clicks on the add-to-cart buttons reported success but didn't register. I used in-page `eval` to click Add to cart, Checkout, Continue and Finish. The Add to cart clicks went through and the badge showed 2. The order went through.
